fresh_remote_receipt.scope: Locked default external-consumer compilation only; no runtime, full-transitive-minimal, other-feature, or other-platform claim.

transitive_minimal_probe.command: RCH_REQUIRE_REMOTE=1 rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rch_target_downstream_consumer_minimal_default CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings -C debuginfo=0' cargo +nightly-2026-08-31 check -j 2 -Z minimal-versions --locked --manifest-path tests/fixtures/downstream-consumer-proof/Cargo.toml --bin default_consumer
transitive_minimal_probe.disposition: Do not add an unused production dependency solely to constrain this transitive range. Keep full transitive-minimal support unclaimed until the upstream range or Cargo policy selects a toolchain-compatible release.

update_policy: Regenerate the independent lock with the exact pinned nightly and direct-minimal command after the root manifest, fixture manifest, toolchain, or tracked lock changes.
Review the lock diff, run the locked remote compile lane, and update all checked hashes and the proof receipt together.
Re-run the full transitive-minimal probe; preserve the precise blocker unless it reaches terminal green without a local fallback or a production-only constraint dependency.
minimum_version_policy.stable_subset_bound: No numeric stable MSRV is declared because Cargo.toml has no rust-version. The separate stable lane remains --no-default-features --features proc-macros.
minimum_version_policy.default_feature_bound: The exact nightly-2026-08-31 snapshot is required because default features include nightly-outcome-try; it is not a numeric MSRV range.

positive_profiles.command: RCH_REQUIRE_REMOTE=1 rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rch_target_downstream_consumer_default CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings -C debuginfo=0' cargo run --manifest-path tests/fixtures/downstream-consumer-proof/Cargo.toml --bin default_consumer
positive_profiles.expected_signal: default_consumer exits 0 after exercising only root public re-exports
